title: Wall Street’s $500 Billion Pledge to Nvidia Hasn’t Materialized
title_zh: 華爾街對輝達的 5,000 億美元承諾，至今沒有兌現
subtitle: 華爾街對輝達的 5,000 億美元承諾，至今沒有兌現
author: Emma Tucker

sentences.en: In August, then-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang lined up pledges from Wall Street heavyweights—including Apollo, Blackstone, BlackRock and Goldman Sachs—to mobilize an astounding sum: $500 billion.
sentences.zh: 今年八月，時任輝達執行長的黃仁勳，向華爾街重量級機構（包括 Apollo、黑石、貝萊德和高盛）爭取到承諾，要動員一筆驚人的金額：5,000 億美元。

sentences.en: The wave of money was supposed to help Nvidia’s customers—including smaller, weaker ones—finance the chips they needed to buy, keeping the chip giant’s sales humming well into the future.
sentences.zh: 這波資金原本是要幫助輝達的客戶（包括規模較小、體質較弱的客戶）籌錢購買所需晶片，讓這家晶片巨頭的銷售在未來很長一段時間都維持順暢。

sentences.en: So far, not a dollar has been deployed, our latest reporting shows.
sentences.zh: 我們最新的報導顯示，到目前為止，一塊錢都還沒有投入。

sentences.en: And investors are increasingly skeptical that the program will reach its lofty ambitions now that Huang has been ousted.
sentences.zh: 而在黃仁勳被趕下台之後，投資人越來越懷疑這個計畫能否達成它遠大的目標。

sentences.en: The Jensen Huang saga has reinvigorated Washington’s China hawks.
sentences.zh: 黃仁勳風波讓華府的對中鷹派重新振作起來。

sentences.en: When Anthropic starts trading publicly this week, its older rival OpenAI will be working on another goal: regaining its lead in the AI race.
sentences.zh: 當 Anthropic 本週開始公開交易時，它的老對手 OpenAI 將忙著另一個目標：奪回在 AI 競賽中的領先地位。

sentences.en: North Carolina’s Piedmont Triad region was once known for its textile, tobacco and furniture-making industries—until they were battered by globalization and offshoring.
sentences.zh: 北卡羅來納州的皮埃蒙特三角區曾以紡織、菸草和家具製造業聞名，直到這些產業遭到全球化和產業外移重創。

sentences.en: More recently, however, the Triad pulled off an unusual feat: It reinvented its economy.
sentences.zh: 不過最近，三角區完成了一項不尋常的成就：它讓自己的經濟脫胎換骨。

sentences.en: The region is now a center for aerospace, advanced manufacturing, life sciences and logistics.
sentences.zh: 這個地區現在是航太、先進製造、生命科學和物流的重鎮。

vocab.usage: make a pledge to do…；pledge + 金額（pledge $1 million 承諾捐 100 萬）；也可當動詞
vocab.example: The company made a pledge to cut emissions.
vocab.example_zh: 公司承諾要減少排放。

vocab.usage: an industry heavyweight 業界大老；Wall Street heavyweights 華爾街大咖
vocab.example: Several tech heavyweights attended the event.
vocab.example_zh: 好幾位科技界大咖出席了活動。

vocab.usage: mobilize funds / resources / support 調集資金／資源／支持
vocab.example: The city mobilized volunteers after the storm.
vocab.example_zh: 暴風雨後，市府動員了志工。

vocab.usage: ＝astonishing / amazing；an astounding sum / number 驚人的金額／數字
vocab.example: The project cost an astounding amount of money.
vocab.example_zh: 這個案子花了驚人的金額。

vocab.usage: finance a purchase / project 為購買／專案融資；名詞 financing 融資
vocab.example: The bank agreed to finance the new factory.
vocab.example_zh: 銀行同意為新工廠融資。

vocab.zh: 投入；部署（資金、人員、系統）
vocab.usage: deploy capital 投入資金；deploy software 部署軟體；名詞 deployment
vocab.example: We will deploy the new system next month.
vocab.example_zh: 我們下個月會部署新系統。

vocab.usage: be skeptical of / about / that…；英式拼法 sceptical
vocab.example: Investors are skeptical about the plan.
vocab.example_zh: 投資人對這個計畫存疑。

vocab.zh: 遠大的；崇高的（有時暗示不切實際）
vocab.usage: lofty goals / ambitions / valuation 遠大的目標／過高的估值
vocab.example: The startup has lofty goals.
vocab.example_zh: 這家新創有很遠大的目標。

vocab.usage: have ambitions to do…；形容詞 ambitious
vocab.example: Her ambition is to open her own company.
vocab.example_zh: 她的抱負是開自己的公司。

vocab.usage: 多用被動：be ousted as CEO 被拔除執行長職位；新聞標題常用
vocab.example: The board ousted the chairman.
vocab.example_zh: 董事會把董事長趕下台了。

vocab.usage: 新聞用語：the ongoing saga 持續中的風波
vocab.example: The merger saga lasted two years.
vocab.example_zh: 這場併購風波持續了兩年。

vocab.usage: a rival company 對手公司；arch-rival 死對頭；也可當形容詞
vocab.example: Our rival lowered its prices.
vocab.example_zh: 我們的對手降價了。

vocab.usage: regain the lead / market share / control 奪回領先／市占率／控制權
vocab.example: The team regained the lead in the second half.
vocab.example_zh: 這支隊伍在下半場奪回領先。

vocab.usage: 相關：outsourcing 外包；reshoring 回流
vocab.example: Offshoring moved many factory jobs overseas.
vocab.example_zh: 產業外移讓許多工廠工作移到海外。

vocab.usage: pull off a feat 完成壯舉；no small feat 不簡單的事
vocab.example: Finishing on time was no small feat.
vocab.example_zh: 準時完成可不是件容易的事。

vocab.usage: reinvent itself / the economy 自我改造；名詞 reinvention
vocab.example: The brand reinvented itself for young buyers.
vocab.example_zh: 這個品牌為了年輕客群重新改造自己。

vocab.usage: logistics center 物流中心；TOEIC 常見於運輸、倉儲題目
vocab.example: He works in logistics at a shipping company.
vocab.example_zh: 他在一家航運公司做物流。

vocab.usage: face / suffer a setback 遇到挫折；a temporary setback 暫時的挫折
vocab.example: The project faced a setback but continued.
vocab.example_zh: 專案遇到挫折，但仍繼續進行。

vocab.usage: 縮寫 FY；fiscal year ending March 截至三月的財年
vocab.example: Our fiscal year ends in December.
vocab.example_zh: 我們的財年在十二月結束。

vocab.usage: launch / price an IPO 推出／訂價 IPO；go public 上市
vocab.example: The company plans an initial public offering next year.
vocab.example_zh: 這家公司計畫明年 IPO。
